title: Score Spanner Payload
description: Spanner start/end points (hairpins, lines) not attached to a chord. One of the event types of the Distant Listening Corpus 'chords' facet (event == 'Spanner'). All columns are parallel arrays; missing values are null.

mc.description: Running count of encoded <Measure> tags which do not necessarily express a full measure (e.g. in case of an anacrusis).

mn.description: Measure number as printed in the score, computed from mc, dont_count and numbering_offset.

quarterbeats.description: Distance from the piece's beginning. By default, only second endings are taken into account to reflect the proportions of a simply playthrough without repeats. Exact fraction.

mc_onset.description: Distance of an event from the beginning of the <Measure> tag. Exact fraction.

mn_onset.description: Distance from the beginning of the logical measure. Relevant, for example, to compute the metric position of an event. Exact fraction.

staff.description: Number of the staff where an event occurs, 1 designating the top staff.

voice.description: A number between 1-4 where 1 is MuseScore's default layer (blue), 2 the second layer in green with downward stems, etc.

duration.description: As fraction of a whole note. Exact fraction.

volta.description: Number of an ending bracket, given as integer.

slur.description: IDs of active slurs that a chord falls under, as a tuple of integers.

crescendo_hairpin.description: IDs of active crescendo hairpins, comma-separated.

decrescendo_hairpin.description: IDs of active decrescendo hairpins, comma-separated.

diminuendo_line.description: IDs of active diminuendo text lines, comma-separated.

crescendo_line.description: IDs of active crescendo text lines, comma-separated.
